message:
I see the issue! In `handle_unicode_code_point`, the check is `if (it + 4 >= end)`. This means it requires `it + 4 < end`, i.e., at least 5 bytes available (`it`, `it+1`, `it+2`, `it+3`, `it+4`). But `hex_to_u32(it)` reads 4 bytes. Wait, let me check `hex_to_u32`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glaze && grep -n "hex_to_u32" include/glaze/util/parse.hpp | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
